name: Grain
description: Film grain added to the picture's perceptual brightness, changing every frame.

params.label: Size
params.doc: The size of a grain in pixels.

params.label: Coloured grain
params.doc: Gives each colour channel its own grain instead of one grey grain.

params.label: Brightness response
params.doc: 0 spreads the grain evenly, 1 keeps it to the midtones and away from black and white.
